items.name: Breakup — closing the loop
items.subject: Closing the loop
items.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I'll take the silence as a 'not right now' and close this out on my side — no more emails from me on this.

If circumstances change at {{company}}, my door stays open. Wishing you a strong quarter.

Best,
{{sender_name}}

items.name: Follow-up — gentle nudge
items.subject: Re: exploring a fit with {{company}}
items.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Following up on my earlier note about the mandate we're running. Timing matters on this one, and I'd still welcome your read on whether it's relevant for {{company}}.

If a call is easier, I can send over a couple of slots.

Best,
{{sender_name}}

items.name: Follow-up — value add
items.subject: One more thought for {{company}}
items.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Since my last note, activity in your space has picked up on our side — we've seen comparable conversations move quickly this quarter.

If exploring this now isn't right for {{company}}, a quick 'not now' is genuinely helpful too.

Best,
{{sender_name}}

items.name: Intro — mandate outreach
items.subject: Exploring a fit with {{company}}
items.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I'm reaching out from our advisory desk — we're running a mandate where {{company}} stands out as a strong potential fit, and I'd value a short conversation to test that read.

Would you be open to a 15-minute call this week or next? Happy to work around your calendar.

Best,
{{sender_name}}
